title: DS event-trace file format
preamble:
# DS event-trace file format

A trace file is a binary sequential file recording the event trace of
one DS engine session — every recordable event the engine emitted, in the
order it emitted them. It is self-describing: every schema needed to decode a
fact is defined in the file before its first use. A reader needs no
external DSC or schema registry.

This document covers the `.dstrace` trace-file format: atom framing, the
`StreamHeader` header, the scalar atoms, and the schema-driven fact-body codec.
Companion protos live in `proto/`:
`proto/stream_header.proto#StreamHeader`,
`proto/stream_header.proto#ClockAdvance`,
`proto/stream_header.proto#RuleFireAnnotation`,
`proto/fact_assert.proto#FactAssert`, `proto/fact_retract.proto#FactRetract`.
Schema atoms (`SchemaDef` / `Slot`) reuse the DSC proto definitions in `proto/`.
